maddeler.e:
أنطبع (form VII)
# أَنْطَبِعُ (ʔanṭabiʕu) /ʔan.tˤa.bi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# أَنْطَبِعَ (ʔanṭabiʕa) /ʔan.tˤa.bi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# أَنْطَبِعْ (ʔanṭabiʕ) /ʔan.tˤa.biʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
